title: Bright numbered clock, loud alarm
text: Bright numbered clock, loud alarm. The numbers are big. It shows the temperature.  It can also be programed to military time. Alarm goes off at 12 midnight every night. I never set the alarm. It won't stop. The seconds stop working not long after purchase. Will not buy again!
